name: ChatGPT Plus
tagline: OpenAI's flagship multi-modal AI assistant with GPT-6 / GPT-6.1 Sol models, Codex agent, voice, and projects.
bestFor: General productivity, frontier reasoning, Codex coding workflows, data analysis, and multi-modal tasks
pros: Expanded access to frontier GPT-6 / GPT-6.1 Sol reasoning models and Codex coding tools
Strong multi-modal suite with advanced voice, image generation, custom Projects, and extended memory
Flexible consumer lineup with Free ($0), Go ($8/mo), Plus ($20/mo), and Pro ($100-$500/mo) tiers
cons: No annual discount on individual Plus ($20/mo) subscriptions
Heavy power users require Pro tiers ($100-$500/mo) for highest limits and Ultrafast mode

name: Claude Pro
tagline: Anthropic's high-context AI assistant featuring Claude Code, Projects, interactive Artifacts, and Fable/Sonnet models.
bestFor: Software engineering, Claude Code terminal workflows, long-document analysis, and nuanced writing
pros: Includes Claude Code, Projects, Artifacts, and 200K+ token context across Sonnet, Haiku, and Fable models
Annual billing reduces Pro to $17/mo ($200/yr); Max ($100/mo) and Ultra ($200/mo) bundle matching API credits
Industry-leading code refactoring accuracy and natural prose quality
cons: Pro enforces 5-hour rolling usage windows; removing the 5-hour cap requires Ultra ($200/mo)
No built-in raster image generation

name: Google AI Pro (Gemini Advanced)
tagline: Google's rebranded Google AI Pro suite combining frontier Gemini models, Deep Research, Workspace AI, and 5TB storage.
bestFor: Google Workspace users, Deep Research reports, long-context video/audio analysis, and cloud storage bundles
pros: Upgraded bundle includes 5 TB Google One cloud storage and Google Flow credits at $19.99/mo ($199.99/yr)
1M+ token context window with native integration across Gmail, Docs, Drive, and Sheets
Entry AI Plus ($4.99/mo, 400GB) and AI Ultra ($99.99+/mo, 20TB+) tiers cover both light and heavy users
cons: YouTube Premium and highest frontier compute quotas require the $99.99+/mo AI Ultra tier

name: Grok (The X Subscription)
tagline: xAI's Grok 4.6/4.7 assistant and developer API, bundled with Cursor and X perks via The X Subscription.
bestFor: Real-time X/web intelligence, bundled Grok + Cursor subscribers, and xAI multi-agent API workloads
pros: Unified X Subscription bundles Grok + Cursor usage starting at $8/mo Plus ($80/yr) and $30/mo Premium
Grok 4.6/4.7 and 4.3/4.20 API models support 500K-1M context windows starting at $1-$2 per 1M input tokens
Includes real-time X platform context, image generation, and video generation on Premium+
cons: Standalone SuperGrok plans were phased out for new sign-ups in favor of The X Subscription bundle
API requests reaching 200K+ tokens double token pricing across the entire prompt

name: DeepSeek
tagline: High-efficiency AI assistant and V4-series reasoning API featuring 1M context, web search, and ultra-low token costs.
bestFor: Cost-sensitive developers, high-volume reasoning APIs, and free consumer chat with web search
pros: Free consumer web and mobile chat with built-in web search, deep thinking, and file/PDF parsing
DeepSeek-Flash (V4.1-Flash) API starts at $0.15/1M input and $0.60/1M output off-peak with 1M context
Automatic context caching drops cache-hit input costs to fractions of a cent per million tokens
cons: Peak weekday API hours (UTC) double token rates compared to off-peak windows
Lacks native video/audio generation or deep Western SaaS office suite integrations

name: Cursor
tagline: AI-first IDE bundled with The X Subscription, offering Cloud Agents, Bugbot code reviews, and weekly usage pools.
bestFor: Full-stack engineers wanting multi-file Cloud Agents, Bugbot PR reviews, and fast Tab autocomplete
pros: Plus tier starts at $8/mo ($80/yr); Premium ($30/mo) unlocks 4x usage, Cloud Agents, Bugbot, and Origin hosting
Seamless VS Code compatibility with codebase indexing and fast multi-line Tab predictions
Bundled with The X Subscription, sharing weekly usage pools across Cursor and Grok
cons: Third-party models (Claude, GPT, Gemini) require Premium ($30/mo+) and bill separately via prepaid API credit
Plus ($8/mo) excludes Cloud Agents, Automations, and Bugbot

name: GitHub Copilot
tagline: GitHub's multi-IDE AI coding assistant powered by GitHub AI Credits across Free, Pro ($10), Pro+ ($39), and Max ($100).
bestFor: Individual developers and enterprise teams standardized on GitHub, VS Code, or JetBrains IDEs
pros: Copilot Free ($0, 2,000 completions/mo) and Pro ($10/mo, unlimited completions + 1,500 AI Credits worth $15)
Scales cleanly with Pro+ ($39/mo, 7,000 credits), Max ($100/mo, 20,000 credits), Business ($19), and Enterprise ($39)
Strong enterprise IP indemnity, no-training privacy guarantees, and native GitHub PR integration
cons: Heavy agentic coding workflows consume monthly GitHub AI Credits quickly on the $10 Pro plan

name: Windsurf
tagline: Agentic AI code editor in the Devin ecosystem with unlimited Tab autocomplete and daily/weekly Cascade quotas.
bestFor: Developers seeking deep autonomous Cascade workflows, unlimited inline edits, and API-rate overages
pros: Unlimited tab autocomplete and inline edits across Free ($0), Pro ($20/mo), Max ($200/mo), and Teams ($40/seat)
Daily/weekly quota model lets paid users continue past caps at transparent public API rates
Access to frontier models (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok) alongside base SWE-1.6 models
cons: Pro entry tier increased from $15 to $20/mo; Teams requires an $80/mo base minimum
No standalone public developer API (IDE-focused)

name: Lovable
tagline: Full-stack AI web application builder with unified Lovable Cloud hosting, custom domains, and clean code export.
bestFor: Founders, product managers, and designers shipping full-stack web apps and MVPs from natural language
pros: Unified credit pool covers AI app building, Lovable Cloud hosting, and embedded in-app AI features
Pro starts at $25/mo (100 monthly credits + 5 daily bonus credits) with private projects and code export
Free tier offers 5 daily credits (~30/mo) and 20 Cloud credits for rapid prototyping
cons: Complex iterative debugging can burn monthly build credits rapidly on lower tiers
Business tier starts at $50/mo for team workspaces and SSO

name: Bolt.new
tagline: Browser-native full-stack AI development sandbox with token-based billing, hosting, and database integrations.
bestFor: Rapid in-browser prototyping, full-stack web deployments, and interactive frontend/backend builds
pros: Generous Free plan includes 1M tokens/month (300K/day cap) and integrated web hosting
Pro ($25/mo) provides 10M tokens/month with 1-month unused token rollover and custom domains
Zero local setup required—runs Node.js, packages, and database connectors directly in the browser
cons: Large multi-file context loops consume token allowances quickly during debugging
Teams plan ($30/member/mo) required for centralized billing and organization sharing

name: Perplexity Pro
tagline: Real-time AI answer and Deep Research engine with live citations, multi-model switching, and Sonar API.
bestFor: Market researchers, journalists, students, and analysts needing verified, cited real-time research
pros: Every answer provides clickable source citations with multi-step Deep Research synthesis
Flexible pricing across Free ($0), Education Pro ($10/mo), Pro ($20/mo or $200/yr), and Max ($200/mo)
Enterprise Pro ($40/seat/mo) adds shared knowledge hubs and admin governance
cons: Less suited for creative fiction writing or multi-file software repository editing
Highest Deep Research and asset limits require the $200/mo Max tier

name: n8n
tagline: Fair-code workflow and AI agent automation platform priced per full workflow execution with free self-hosting.
bestFor: Technical builders, DevOps teams, and agencies building multi-step AI agents and API workflows
pros: Free self-hosted Community Edition; Cloud Starter is $20/mo billed annually ($24/mo monthly) for 2,500 executions
Charged per complete workflow run regardless of step count, with unlimited users and workflows
Native AI Agent, memory, and LangChain nodes plus custom JavaScript/Python support
cons: Steeper technical learning curve than consumer no-code tools
Cloud Pro ($50/mo annual, $60/mo monthly) needed for 10,000 executions and 50 concurrent runs

name: Make (formerly Integromat)
tagline: Visual drag-and-drop automation canvas with credit-based pricing, Make Code JS/Python app, and 1,500+ apps.
bestFor: No-code operators, marketers, and SMBs automating CRM, content, and AI API pipelines visually
pros: Free plan includes 1,000 credits/mo; Core starts at $12/mo annual ($16/mo monthly) for 10,000 credits/mo
Highly visual scenario builder with real-time execution inspection and 1-minute scheduling on paid plans
Routers and filters do not consume credits; includes Make API and Make Code app
cons: Unused monthly credits expire at billing cycle end and complex loops consume credits rapidly
No self-hosted open-source deployment option

name: Zapier
tagline: The largest no-code automation ecosystem with 6,000+ app connectors, Tables, Interfaces, and AI workflows.
bestFor: Non-technical teams needing instant connectors across niche enterprise and SMB SaaS tools
pros: Unmatched ecosystem of 6,000+ integrations plus Zapier Tables and Interfaces even on Free (100 tasks/mo)

Filters, Paths, Formatters, and Triggers do not count against monthly task limits
cons: Task-based pricing scales up steeply for high-volume workflows; Team starts at $69/mo annual ($103.50 monthly)

name: ElevenLabs
tagline: Studio-grade AI voice, dubbing, sound effects, music, and conversational voice agent platform with credit rollover.
bestFor: Content creators, audiobook publishers, game studios, and low-latency conversational voice AI apps

Unified credit pool covers TTS, dubbing, SFX, music, and voice agents with 2-month rollover on paid plans
Creator ($22/mo, 121k credits) unlocks Professional Voice Cloning; Pro ($99/mo) unlocks 44.1kHz PCM API
cons: Free tier (10,000 credits/mo) excludes commercial usage rights
Dubbing and complex multi-speaker workflows consume credits faster than standard TTS

name: Runway
tagline: Flagship AI video creation studio and Runway Dev API powered by Gen-4, Gen-4.5, and Aleph 2.0 models.

Runway Dev API offers pay-per-second video generation ($0.05/sec Gen-4 Turbo, $0.12/sec Gen-4.5)

Older Unlimited tier was replaced by the credit-capped Max plan

name: Suno
tagline: AI music creation platform and Suno Studio browser DAW with stem separation and commercial licensing.
bestFor: Musicians, video creators, podcasters, and indie studios generating original tracks and stems

Paid tiers include commercial usage rights and multi-track stem separation
cons: No official self-serve public developer API available
Monthly track download caps apply (20 on Pro, 60 on Premier, 120 on Platinum)

tagline: Premier AI image generation platform offering Fast GPU hours, Unlimited Relax mode, and Stealth privacy.
bestFor: Art directors, concept artists, brand designers, and agencies needing photorealistic and stylized imagery
pros: Basic starts at $8/mo annual ($10/mo monthly) for ~3.3 Fast GPU hours (~200 images)

Basic plan excludes Relax mode, Stealth Mode, and commercial usage rights
